title: Minima of geodesic length functions for non-uniform filling systems
summary: Kerckhoff proved that the geodesic length function $\ell_Ω$ of a filling $Ω$ on $S_g$ attains a unique minimum in Teichmüller space. Recent work of Ernesto Girondo et al. computed these minima for uniform fillings using the algebraic machinery of dessins d'enfants and Grothendieck-Belyi surfaces. We present an elementary optimization approach for $4$-regular topological uniform fillings, bypassing this framework.
